inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: A ceasefire that gives Tehran greater leverage over the Strait of Hormuz would be a dangerous bargain, not a foundation for peace. The five counter-conditions make clear that the sides remain far apart, and pressure should not be rewarded simply because leaders want a deal. Israel must retain the ability to protect its people, and America should defend security and order rather than legitimize coercion. When governments mistake appeasement for peace, ordinary families are left to live with the consequences.
